findings.event: Sandoz obtains option on HLXTE-HAase1001 as part of up to-$322M, 10-asset mAb/ADC biosimilar collaboration
findings.source_name: Shanghai Henlius Biotech press release (PR Newswire/Kyodo syndication)
findings.summary: Henlius named and licensed an option on its own hyaluronidase enzyme (HLXTE-HAase1001) to Sandoz for the first time, explicitly for IV-to-SC conversion -- a sixth independent hyaluronidase-based SC-conversion platform alongside ENHANZE, ALT-B4/Hybrozyme, Samsung Bioepis' PH20 technology, HyDiffuse, and Amicogen's variant.
findings.summary_ko: Henlius가 처음으로 자사의 히알루로니다제 효소(HLXTE-HAase1001)를 명명하고 이에 대한 옵션을 산도스에 라이선스했다 -- 명시적으로 IV-SC 전환 목적이며, ENHANZE, ALT-B4/Hybrozyme, 삼성바이오에피스 PH20 기술, HyDiffuse, 아미코젠 변이체에 이은 여섯 번째의 독립적인 히알루로니다제 기반 SC 전환 플랫폼이다.
